steps.instruction: Pull the sheets for these parts and check each one for flatness, edge damage, and the face you want showing.

steps.title: Break down the Birch plywood 18
steps.instruction: Break the sheets down into the listed parts with the face grain running along each part length unless the design says otherwise.

steps.title: Break down the Birch plywood 6
steps.instruction: Break the sheets down into the listed parts with the face grain running along each part length unless the design says otherwise.

checklist.text: Write B1 on the Bottom; keep the front face clean
Write T1 on the Top; keep the front face clean
Write H1 on the Lower shelf; keep the front face clean
Write H2 on the Middle shelf; keep the front face clean
Write H3 on the Upper shelf; keep the front face clean
Write S1 on the Left side; keep the left, front faces clean
Write S2 on the Right side; keep the right, front faces clean
Write K1 on the Back

steps.title: Mark every part
steps.instruction: Write each part mark on its reference face, and note which faces show on the finished piece so the best faces end up there.

checklist.text: A test cut on scrap fits the mating part
Cut dados on the Left side (dado-bottom-l)
Cut dados on the Right side (dado-bottom-r)
Cut dados on the Left side (dado-top-l)
Cut dados on the Right side (dado-top-r)
Cut dados on the Left side (dado-shelf-1-l)
Cut dados on the Right side (dado-shelf-1-r)
Cut dados on the Left side (dado-shelf-2-l)
Cut dados on the Right side (dado-shelf-2-r)
Cut dados on the Left side (dado-shelf-3-l)
Cut dados on the Right side (dado-shelf-3-r)

steps.title: Cut the dados
steps.instruction: Set up the table saw from the setup values. Test the setup on scrap and check the fit, then cut each marked part.

checklist.text: A test cut on scrap fits the mating part
Cut rabbets on the Left side (rabbet-back-l)
Cut rabbets on the Right side (rabbet-back-r)

steps.title: Cut the rabbets
steps.instruction: Set up the router table from the setup values. Test the setup on scrap and check the fit, then cut each marked part.

checklist.text: A test cut on scrap fits the mating part
Drill pilot holes on the Back (screw-back-bottom)
Drill pilot holes on the Back (screw-back-top)

steps.title: Drill the pilot holes
steps.instruction: Set up the drill from the setup values. Test the setup on scrap and check the fit, then drill each marked part.

checklist.text: Every joint closes with no gap
The unit sits square and flat

steps.title: Dry fit the carcass
steps.instruction: Fit the parts together without glue, check that every joint closes and the unit is square, then take it apart and keep the parts in order.

checklist.text: Every joint closes with no gap
The unit sits square and flat

steps.title: Dry fit the whole piece
steps.instruction: Fit every assembly and loose part together without glue to confirm the whole piece goes together, then take it apart.

checklist.text: Joint surfaces and tenon cheeks stay unsanded so the fits stay tight

steps.title: Sand the inside faces
steps.instruction: Sand the faces that will be hard to reach once the parts are glued, working through the grits and keeping paper off the joint surfaces.

checklist.text: The dry fit closed cleanly
Close the dado joint: Bottom to Left side
Close the dado joint: Bottom to Right side
Close the dado joint: Top to Left side
Close the dado joint: Top to Right side
Close the dado joint: Lower shelf to Left side
Close the dado joint: Lower shelf to Right side
Close the dado joint: Middle shelf to Left side
Close the dado joint: Middle shelf to Right side
Close the dado joint: Upper shelf to Left side
Close the dado joint: Upper shelf to Right side

steps.title: Glue and clamp the carcass
steps.instruction: Spread glue on the joints, bring the parts together in the dry-fit order, and clamp evenly, checking the unit stays square.

steps.title: Let the carcass glue set
steps.instruction: Leave the assembly clamped until the glue has set.

checklist.text: Close the rabbet joint: Back to Left side
Close the rabbet joint: Back to Right side
Close the screw joint: Back to Bottom
Close the screw joint: Back to Top

steps.title: Assemble the whole piece
steps.instruction: Bring the parts together in the dry-fit order and fasten them without glue.

steps.title: Apply the finish
steps.instruction: Do the final sanding through the grits, remove the dust, and apply the finish in thin coats.

steps.title: Let the finish dry
steps.instruction: Leave the piece undisturbed until the finish has dried hard enough to handle.
